name: Hybrid Amplifier
reasoning: Sized for real listening levels and future expansion.
tradeoff: More headroom than a TV bar without a branded ecosystem.

name: Signal Splitter
reasoning: Bridges modern sources with affordable, serviceable hardware.
tradeoff: One intentional conversion point to keep the system understandable.

name: Passive Speakers
reasoning: Distributed sources create a wider listening field.
tradeoff: Placement matters more than badge value.

name: Dedicated Subwoofer
reasoning: Separates room energy from dialogue and detail.
tradeoff: Needs measured placement to avoid standing-wave buildup.
